content: People have enough to live by, but nothing to live for; they have the means, but no meaning.
author: Viktor Frankl
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

Viktor Frankl understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
